an7.56:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
an7.56:1.3: Atha kho dve devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ Gijjhakūṭaṃ obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho ekā devatā Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an7.56:1.9: Atha kho tā devatā ‘samanuñño Satthā' ti Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth' ev' antaradhāyiṃsu.
an7.56:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena bhikkhū āmantesi
an7.56:2.2: ‘imaṃ bhikkhave rattiṃ dve devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ Gijjhakūṭaṃ obhāsetvā yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho bhikkhave ekā devatā maṃ etad avoca
an7.56:2.7: idaṃ vatvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth' ev' antaradhāyiṃsū' ti. 2.
an7.56:3.1: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno Bhagavato avidūre nisinno hoti.
an7.56:3.2: Atha kho āyasmato Mahāmoggallānassa etad ahosi
an7.56:3.4: sa-upādisese vā sa-upādiseso ti anupādisese vā anupādiseso' ti.
an7.56:3.5: Tena kho pana samayena Tisso nāma bhikkhu adhunā kālakato aññataraṃ Brahmalokaṃ upapanno hoti.
an7.56:4.1: Atha kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno, seyyathā pi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam eva Gijjhakūṭe pabbate antarahito tasmiṃ Brahmaloke pāturahosi.
an7.56:4.2: Addasā kho Tisso Brahmā āyasmantaṃ Mahāmoggallānaṃ dūrato 'va āgacchantaṃ,
an7.56:4.6: cirassaṃ kho mārisa Moggallāna imaṃ pariyāyamam akāsi, yad idaṃ idhāgamanāya,
an7.56:4.7: nisīda mārisa Moggallāna, idam āsanaṃ paññattan' ti.
an7.56:4.8: Nisīdi kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno paññatte āsane.
an7.56:4.9: Tisso pi kho Brahmā āyasmantaṃ Mahāmoggallānaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an7.56:4.10: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Tissaṃ Brahmānaṃ āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno etad avoca
an7.56:4.11: ‘katamesānaṃ kho Tissa devānaṃ evaṃ ñāṇaṃ hoti:
an7.56:4.12: sa-upādisese vā sa-upādiseso ti anupādisese vā anupādiseso' ti.
an7.56:4.13: ‘Brahmakāyikānaṃ kho mārisa Moggallāna devānaṃ evaṃ ñāṇaṃ hoti:
an7.56:4.14: sa-upādisese vā sa-upādiseso ti anupādisese vā anupādiseso' ti. ‘Sabbesaṃ
an7.56:5.1: yeva kho Tissa Brahmakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ evaṃ ñāṇaṃ hoti:
an7.56:5.2: saupādisese vā sa-upādiseso ti anupādisese vā anupādiseso' ti? 3.
an7.56:5.3: Na kho mārisa Moggallāna sabbesaṃ Brahmakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ evaṃ ñāṇaṃ hoti:
an7.56:5.4: sa-upādisese vā sa-upādiseso ti anupādisese vā anupādiseso ti.
an7.56:6.1: Ye kho te mārisa Moggallāna Brahmakāyikā devā brahmena āyunā santuṭṭhā, brahmena vaṇṇena brahmena sukhena brahmena yasena brahmena ādhipateyyena santuṭṭhā tassa ca uttariṃ nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ na ppajānanti,
an7.56:6.3: sa-upādisese vā sa-upādiseso ti anupādisese vā anupādiseso ti;
an7.56:6.4: ye ca kho te mārisa Moggallāna Brahmakāyikā devā brahmena āyunā asantuṭṭhā, brahmena vaṇṇena brahmena sukhena brahmena yasena brahmena ādhipateyyena asantuṭṭhā tassa ca uttariṃ nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti,
an7.56:6.6: saupādisese vā sa-upādiseso ti anupādisese vā anupādiseso ti. 4.
an7.56:7.1: Idha mārisa Moggallāna bhikkhu ubhato bhāgavimutto hoti,
an7.56:7.2: tam enaṃ te devā evaṃ jānanti:
an7.56:7.4: yāv' assa kāyo ṭhassati, tāva naṃ dakkhinti devamanussā,
an7.56:7.5: kāyassa bhedā na naṃ dakkhinti devamanussā ti.
an7.56:7.6: Evam pi kho mārisa Moggallāna tesaṃ devānaṃ ñāṇaṃ hoti:
an7.56:8.1: Idha pana mārisa Moggallāna bhikkhu paññāvimutto hoti,
an7.56:8.2: tam enaṃ te devā evaṃ jānanti:
an7.56:8.4: yāv' assa kāyo ṭhassati, tāva naṃ dakkhinti devamanussā,
an7.56:8.5: kāyassa bhedā na naṃ dakkhinti devamanussā ti.
an7.56:8.6: Evam pi kho mārisa Moggallāna tesaṃ devānaṃ ñāṇaṃ hoti:
an7.56:9.1: Idha pana mārisa Moggallāna bhikkhu kāyasakkhi hoti,
an7.56:9.2: tam enaṃ te devā evaṃ jānanti:
an7.56:9.4: app eva nāma ayam āyasmā anulomikāni senāsanāni paṭisevamāno kalyāṇamitte bhajamāno indriyāni samannānayamāno,
an7.56:9.5: yass' atthāya kulaputtā samma-d-eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tad anuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyā ti.
an7.56:9.6: Evam pi kho mārisa Moggallāna tesaṃ devānaṃ ñāṇaṃ hoti:
an7.56:10.1: Idha pana mārisa Moggallāna bhikkhu diṭṭhippatto hoti . . . pe . . .
an7.56:10.4: tam enaṃ te devā evaṃ jānanti:
an7.56:10.6: app eva nāma ayam āyasmā anulomikāni senāsanāni paṭisevamāno kalyāṇamitte bhajamāno indriyāni samannānayamāno,
an7.56:10.7: yass' atthāya kulaputtā samma-d-eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tad anuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyā ti.
an7.56:10.8: Evam pi kho mārisa Moggallāna tesaṃ devānaṃ ñāṇaṃ hoti:
an7.56:11.1: Atha kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno Tissassa Brahmuno bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā, seyyathā pi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam eva Brahmaloke antarahito Gijjhakūṭe pabbate pāturahosi.
an7.56:11.2: Atha kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an7.56:11.3: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno, yāvatako ahosi Tissena Brahmunā saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo, taṃ sabbaṃ Bhagavato ārocesi.
an7.56:12.1: ‘Na hi pana te Moggallāna Tisso Brahmā sattamaṃ animittavihāriṃ puggalaṃ desesī' ti.
an7.56:12.3: yaṃ Bhagavā sattamaṃ animittavihāriṃ puggalaṃ deseyya, Bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantī' ti.
an7.56:12.4: ‘Tena hi Moggallāna suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi, bhāsissāmī' ti.
an7.56:12.5: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno Bhagavato paccassosi.
an7.56:13.1: Idha Moggallāna bhikkhu sabbanimittānaṃ amanasikārā animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ upasampajja viharati,
an7.56:13.2: tam enaṃ te devā evaṃ jānanti:
an7.56:13.3: ayaṃ kho āyasmā sabbanimittānaṃ amanasikārā animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ upasampajja viharati,
an7.56:13.4: app eva nāma ayam āyasmā anulomikāni senāsanāni paṭisevamāno kalyāṇamitte bhajamāno indriyāni samannānayamāno,
an7.56:13.5: yass' atthāya kulaputtā sammad-eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tad anuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyā ti.
an7.56:13.6: Evaṃ kho Moggallāna tesaṃ devānaṃ ñāṇaṃ hoti:
